title: Taiwan's AUO, Innolux bet on glass as next-gen AI chip material
key_facts: AUO showcased a glass-core substrate at Semicon Taiwan in early September.
Standfirst: warp resistance of the novel substrate means bigger, more powerful circuit boards.
quote_evidence: AUO, a major Taiwanese maker of display panels, drew attention when it showcased a glass-core substrate for semiconductors at Semicon Taiwan.
why_it_matters_hint: Glass could let AI chip packages grow.
